label: Deleuze championed Spinoza plane of immanence against theological transcendence
description: Gilles Deleuze took up the concept of "Pantheism (Deus Sive Natura)" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Pantheism (Deus Sive Natura)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
